name: trailer-observatory
description: Observe public YouTube trailers remotely with timestamped visual evidence and a free open vision model.

interface.shortDescription: Remote trailer evidence and edit benchmarks
interface.longDescription: A lightweight Python control plane dispatches public trailer research to a standard GitHub-hosted Linux worker. It returns one-second evidence bins, draft visual observations, contact review and measured pacing proxies without vidIQ, paid models, subscriptions or local video decoding.
defaultPrompt: Use Trailer Observatory to inspect an authorized public YouTube trailer corpus and compare its evidence metrics with my original trailer.
